text:
QUOTE: Callbacks are queued and run on the engine thread via `process_events()` (`server_manager.cpp:710`). ... The health monitor queues events and the engine thread drains them.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the health monitor queues events under `event_mutex_` and the engine thread drains them via `process_events()`. That means the callback does not run on the monitor thread.
